# What this notebook does

It writes every number the Latinobarómetro Explorer shows. The website does no
statistics of its own beyond what its methodology note documents: re-basing
percentages from the valid to the asked denominator, summing the answers a
user selects, averaging country estimates into regional lines, and turning a
correlation and its N into a p-value.

| Output (in `public/data/`) | Content |
|---|---|
| `manifest.json` | survey, years, countries (N per year), subgroups, country sets |
| `index.json` | the question catalogue: type, years asked, default indicator, comparability notes |
| `v/<var>.json` | all respondents, every year: weighted distributions, means, SEs and N by country-year |
| `g/<var>.json` | the same by subgroup (gender, age, education, town size), loaded on demand |
| `r/<year>/index.json`, `r/<year>/<var>.json` | within-country correlations of `<var>` with every eligible item that year |

It follows `LB_Trend_Analysis_Instructions.md` (in `Data Cleaning/`): the clean
file only, always weighted, both denominators, fixed country sets, a real year
axis, comparability breaks never bridged. The core helpers (`lb_cy_share()`,
`lb_cy_mean()`, `lb_region()`) come from `LB_functions.R`, sourced from the data
folder, and every check below compares the site's numbers against them.

Every check is a `stopifnot()`, so **a knit that finishes means every check passed.**
Output is written to a staging folder and replaces `public/data` only at the end.

**To rebuild** (R 4.3.3, haven 2.5.4, data.table 1.14.10, jsonlite 1.8.8; about 15 minutes, ~5 GB RAM):

```r
Sys.setenv(LB_DATA_DIR = "~/Desktop/Larry RA/Latinobarometro Data")
rmarkdown::render("build_site_data.Rmd")     # from inside pipeline/
```

Then run the independent Python re-check and the browser-code check:

```sh
LB_DATA_DIR=".../Latinobarometro Data" python3 pipeline/verify_site_data.py
node pipeline/check_regions.mjs
```

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(haven); library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(purrr); library(data.table); library(jsonlite)
})
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
PIPELINE_DIR <- normalizePath(".")
for (f in sort(list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))) source(f)
stopifnot(file.exists(CLEAN_FILE), file.exists(LB_FUNCTIONS), file.exists(CATALOG),
          file.exists(COUNTRY_YEAR), file.exists(CROSSWALK))
source(LB_FUNCTIONS)          # LB_SURVEY_YEARS, LB_COUNTRIES, LB_SET_*, LB_SECTIONS, lb_cy_share(), lb_cy_mean(), lb_region()

countries <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "countries.csv"), colClasses = c(iso_numeric = "character"))
iso_of    <- setNames(countries$iso2, countries$lb_code)
code_of   <- setNames(countries$lb_code, countries$iso2)
overrides <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "variable_overrides.csv"))
trend_ind <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "trend_indicators.csv"), colClasses = "character")
trend_brk <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "trend_breaks.csv"), colClasses = "character")
catalog   <- read.csv(CATALOG, check.names = FALSE) |> filter(in_clean_file)
cy_ref    <- read.csv(COUNTRY_YEAR)
xw        <- read_lb_crosswalk()

# the country list here must be LB_functions.R's
stopifnot(setequal(countries$lb_code, LB_COUNTRIES$country_code),
          all(countries$iso3 == LB_COUNTRIES$iso3[match(countries$lb_code, LB_COUNTRIES$country_code)]))
# the LB-defined sets must match LB_functions.R
for (s in COUNTRY_SETS) if (!is.null(s$lb)) stopifnot(setequal(code_of[s$countries], get(s$lb)))

YEARS <- if (length(BUILD_YEARS)) intersect(LB_SURVEY_YEARS, BUILD_YEARS) else LB_SURVEY_YEARS
sources <- tibble(file = basename(c(CLEAN_FILE, LB_FUNCTIONS, CATALOG, COUNTRY_YEAR, CROSSWALK)),
                  md5 = md5(c(CLEAN_FILE, LB_FUNCTIONS, CATALOG, COUNTRY_YEAR, CROSSWALK)))
sources

FINAL_DIR <- OUT_DIR

unlink(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE); dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(REVIEW_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# The clean file

Read once with `user_na = TRUE`, so every negative code is kept and classified
by code (don't know / no answer = −1, −2, −5; everything else = not asked).
Columns are stored as integers where possible to halve the memory.

```{r read}
raw <- read_sav(CLEAN_FILE, user_na = TRUE)
stopifnot(nrow(raw) == 457499, ncol(raw) == 561)
var_label <- vapply(raw, function(x) attr(x, "label", exact = TRUE) %||% NA_character_, "")
val_labels <- lapply(raw, function(x) attr(x, "labels", exact = TRUE))
lb <- as.data.table(lapply(raw, function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) return(x)
  v <- as.double(vctrs::vec_data(x))
  if (all(is.na(v) | (v == round(v) & abs(v) < 2e9))) as.integer(v) else v
}))
rm(raw); invisible(gc())

# Labels the merge lacks for some codes, taken from the yearly files (config/code_labels.csv)
code_labels <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "code_labels.csv"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(code_labels))) {
  v <- code_labels$variable[i]; l <- val_labels[[v]]
  stopifnot(!code_labels$code[i] %in% l)
  val_labels[[v]] <- c(l, setNames(as.integer(code_labels$code[i]), code_labels$label[i]))
}
code_labels

# the analysis-helper view of the same data (for the checks): labelled columns
# are not needed by lb_cy_share()/lb_cy_mean(), which read vctrs::vec_data()
stopifnot(!any(lb$country_code == LB_SPAIN), all(lb$year %in% LB_SURVEY_YEARS),
          !anyNA(lb$weight), all(lb$weight > 0))
lb[, iso := unname(iso_of[as.character(country_code)])]
stopifnot(!anyNA(lb$iso))
if (length(BUILD_YEARS)) lb <- lb[year %in% YEARS]

# N per country-year equals LB_TimeSeries_Clean_v1_country_year.csv
cy_n <- lb[, .(n = .N, wmean = mean(weight)), by = .(year, country_code)]
cmp_n <- merge(cy_n, as.data.table(cy_ref)[year %in% YEARS], by = c("year", "country_code"), all = TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyNA(cmp_n$n.x), !anyNA(cmp_n$n.y), all(cmp_n$n.x == cmp_n$n.y),
          max(abs(cmp_n$wmean - cmp_n$weight_mean)) < 1e-6)
cat(nrow(lb), "respondents,", length(YEARS), "years,", nrow(cy_n), "country-years\n")
# weights: within-country-year, mean 1 (Uruguay 1995 1.04 and 2002 0.99 as documented)
cy_n |> filter(abs(wmean - 1) > 0.005)
```

# Subgroups

```{r subgroups}
build_memberships <- function(demo) {
  out <- list(data.table(row = seq_len(nrow(demo)), grp = "all"))
  for (s in SUBGROUPS) {
    v <- demo[[s$source]]
    for (g in s$groups) {
      hit <- if (!is.null(g$codes)) v %in% g$codes else !is.na(v) & v >= g$range[1] & v <= g$range[2]
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.table(row = which(hit), grp = g$id)
    }
  }
  m <- rbindlist(out)
  m[, grp := factor(grp, levels = GROUP_IDS)]
  setkey(m, row)
  m
}
memb <- build_memberships(lb)
memb[, .N, by = grp]
# each respondent is in at most one group per dimension
for (s in SUBGROUPS) {
  ids <- vapply(s$groups, `[[`, "", "id")
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(memb[grp %in% ids, row]))
}
# town size exists only from 2001
stopifnot(!any(lb$year[memb[grp %in% c("town_cap", "town_big", "town_small"), row]] < 2001))
cy_key <- paste0(lb$year, "_", lb$iso)
wt <- lb$weight
```

# Catalogue

```{r catalogue}
qvars <- setdiff(names(lb), c(ADMIN_VARS, "iso"))
stopifnot(length(qvars) == 552, setequal(qvars, catalog$variable))
cat_rows <- list(); ct_list <- list()
for (v in qvars) {
  xv <- as.numeric(lb[[v]])
  ct <- code_table(val_labels[[v]], xv)
  t <- var_type_one(v, var_label[[v]], xv, ct)
  ov <- overrides[overrides$variable == v, ]
  if (nrow(ov)) t <- list(type = ov$type[1], reason = paste("override:", ov$note[1]))
  ct_list[[v]] <- ct
  pos_nr <- ct |> filter(code >= 0, class == "nonresponse", observed)
  off <- ct |> filter(class == "offscale", observed)
  cat_rows[[v]] <- tibble(variable = v, label = catalog$label[match(v, catalog$variable)],
    section = section_of(v), type = t$type, reason = t$reason,
    n_scale = sum(ct$class == "substantive" & ct$observed),
    offscale = paste(sprintf("%g=%s", off$code, off$label), collapse = "; "),
    positive_nonresponse = paste(sprintf("%g=%s", pos_nr$code, pos_nr$label), collapse = "; "))
}
catalogue <- bind_rows(cat_rows)
# observed answer codes that still have no label (shown by their number): for review
unlabelled <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ct_list), function(v) {
  z <- ct_list[[v]] |> filter(observed, code >= 0, is.na(label))
  if (nrow(z)) tibble(variable = v, codes = paste(head(z$code, 15), collapse = " "), n_codes = nrow(z), class = paste(unique(z$class), collapse = "/"))
}))
write.csv(unlabelled, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "unlabelled_codes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(catalogue, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "catalogue_review.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
catalogue |> count(type)
# positive codes counted as nonresponse here but as valid by lb_cy_share(): logged for review
catalogue |> filter(positive_nonresponse != "") |> select(variable, label, positive_nonresponse)
catalogue |> filter(offscale != "") |> select(variable, type, offscale)
# variables set to "exclude" in config/variable_overrides.csv are not published (S_003 birthdate)
catalogue |> filter(type == "exclude") |> select(variable, label, reason)
catalogue <- catalogue |> filter(type != "exclude"); qvars <- catalogue$variable
if (length(BUILD_YEARS)) { qvars <- catalogue$variable[catalogue$type != "empty"]; catalogue <- catalogue |> filter(type != "empty") }
stopifnot(!any(catalogue$type %in% c("admin", "text", "empty")))
```

# Estimates: one file per question, all years

For every question: weighted % of valid answers per code, nonresponse % of the
asked, unweighted counts, mean / SD / SE / Kish effective N for every
country-year × group. All-respondent cells go in `v/<var>.json`; subgroup
cells in `g/<var>.json`.

```{r estimates}
yr_of  <- function(k) as.integer(sub("_.*$", "", k))
cc_of  <- function(k) sub("^\\d+_", "", k)
# Subgroup cells are slimmed to what the views use: no per-code counts or SD,
# Kish effective N to the nearest integer.
slim <- function(cell) { cell$c <- NULL; cell$sd <- NULL; if (!is.null(cell$ne)) cell$ne <- round(cell$ne); cell }
nest_cy <- function(est, groups) {
  out <- list()
  for (k in names(est)) {
    cell <- est[[k]][intersect(groups, names(est[[k]]))]
    if (!identical(groups, "all")) cell <- lapply(cell, slim)
    if (!length(cell)) next
    y <- as.character(yr_of(k)); cc <- cc_of(k)
    if (is.null(out[[y]])) out[[y]] <- list()
    out[[y]][[cc]] <- if (identical(groups, "all")) cell$all else cell
  }
  out[order(as.integer(names(out)))] |> lapply(function(z) z[order(names(z))])
}

index_vars <- list(); file_sizes <- list(); corr_names <- character(); var_meta <- list(); all_nr <- list()
sub_groups <- setdiff(GROUP_IDS, "all")
t0 <- Sys.time()
for (v in qvars) {
  cr <- catalogue[catalogue$variable == v, ]
  ty <- cr$type; ct <- ct_list[[v]]
  xv <- as.numeric(lb[[v]])
  cls <- ct$class[match(xv, ct$code)]
  cls[is.na(xv)] <- "not_asked"
  # collapse every nonresponse code into one "Don't know / no answer" (-1)
  nr_raw <- sort(unique(xv[cls == "nonresponse"]))
  x <- xv; x[cls == "nonresponse"] <- -1
  # display codes: observed answers, plus (for scales) labelled codes inside the observed range
  obs_sub <- ct$code[ct$class == "substantive" & ct$observed]
  sub <- ct |> filter(class %in% c("substantive", "offscale"),
                      observed | (ty != "nominal" & !is.na(label) & code >= min(obs_sub) & code <= max(obs_sub))) |>
    arrange(class != "substantive", code)
  with_mean <- ty != "nominal"
  if (ty == "continuous") {
    bins <- make_bins(xv[cls == "substantive"])
    xbin <- bin_index(xv, bins)
    codes <- seq_along(bins$labels); labels <- bins$labels
  } else {
    xbin <- NULL; codes <- sub$code
    labels <- ifelse(is.na(sub$label), format(sub$code, trim = TRUE), sub$label)
  }
  sparse <- ty == "nominal" && length(codes) > 25
  keep <- cls %in% c("substantive", "offscale", "nonresponse")
  m_v <- memb[keep[row]]
  est <- estimate_cells(x, cls, codes, if (length(nr_raw)) -1 else numeric(), cy_key, wt, m_v, with_mean, xbin, sparse)
  # A country-year in which every answer is nonresponse is a question that was not
  # really asked there (e.g. confidence in the armed forces in Costa Rica and Panama,
  # which have none: the merge codes all 1,000 answers -2). It is not published.
  nr_only <- names(est)[vapply(est, function(e) (e$all$nv %||% 0) == 0, logical(1))]
  if (length(nr_only)) all_nr[[v]] <- tibble(variable = v, year = yr_of(nr_only), iso2 = cc_of(nr_only),
                                              n = vapply(est[nr_only], function(e) e$all$n, 0))
  est <- est[!names(est) %in% nr_only]
  if (!length(est)) next
  est_all <- nest_cy(est, "all")
  est_grp <- nest_cy(est, sub_groups)
  years <- as.integer(names(est_all))

  scale_codes <- if (ty == "continuous") numeric() else sub$code[sub$class == "substantive"]
  ind <- default_indicator(v, ty, scale_codes, trend_ind)
  if (is.null(ind)) {             # nominal: most common answer in the latest year (mean over countries)
    last <- est_all[[length(est_all)]]
    tot <- list()
    for (cell in last) { kk <- if (!is.null(cell$k)) cell$k else codes
      for (i in seq_along(kk)) tot[[as.character(kk[i])]] <- (tot[[as.character(kk[i])]] %||% 0) + cell$p[i] }
    ind <- list(type = "share", codes = arr(as.numeric(names(which.max(unlist(tot))))))
  }
  mean_ok <- mean_allowed(ty, scale_codes)
  brk <- trend_breaks(v, trend_brk)
  rec <- list(id = v, type = ty, codes = arr(codes), labels = arr(labels),
              nr = arr(if (length(nr_raw)) -1 else numeric()), nr_labels = arr(if (length(nr_raw)) NR_LABEL else character()),
              nr_raw = arr(nr_raw), sparse = sparse, years = arr(years))
  if (ty != "continuous" && any(sub$class == "offscale")) rec$offscale <- arr(sub$code[sub$class == "offscale"])
  if (ty == "continuous") rec$range <- arr(range(xv[cls == "substantive"], na.rm = TRUE))
  if (ty == "nominal") {          # the answer list offered (observed) each year: trends compare within lists
    rec$yc <- lapply(split(xv[cls %in% c("substantive", "offscale")], lb$year[cls %in% c("substantive", "offscale")]),
                     function(z) arr(sort(unique(z))))
  }
  if (!is.null(xw$qn[[v]])) rec$qn <- xw$qn[[v]]
  if (!is.na(xw$title_es[v])) rec$title_es <- unname(xw$title_es[v])
  rec$est <- est_all
  file_sizes[[length(file_sizes) + 1]] <- tibble(kind = "v", id = v, year = NA,
    bytes = write_json_compact(rec, file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json"))))
  for (y in names(est_grp))      # one subgroup file per question and year, loaded on demand
    file_sizes[[length(file_sizes) + 1]] <- tibble(kind = "g", id = v, year = as.integer(y),
      bytes = write_json_compact(list(id = v, year = as.integer(y), est = est_grp[[y]]), file.path(OUT_DIR, "g", y, paste0(v, ".json"))))

  entry <- list(id = v, q = cr$label, s = cr$section, t = ty, k = length(codes), y = arr(years), d = ind, m = mean_ok)
  if (ty %in% c("ordinal", "binary")) {
    on <- sub$label[sub$class == "substantive"]; oc <- sub$code[sub$class == "substantive"]
    entry$ends <- arr(c(sprintf("%g = %s", oc[1], on[1]), sprintf("%g = %s", oc[length(oc)], on[length(on)])))
  }
  note <- catalog$audit_note[match(v, catalog$variable)]
  if (!is.na(note) && nzchar(note)) entry$note <- note
  if (!is.null(brk)) entry$tb <- brk
  if (v %in% trend_ind$variable && trend_ind$featured[trend_ind$variable == v] == "1") entry$f <- 1L
  if (v %in% trend_ind$variable && nzchar(trend_ind$default_set[trend_ind$variable == v])) entry$ds <- trend_ind$default_set[trend_ind$variable == v]
  index_vars[[length(index_vars) + 1]] <- entry
  var_meta[[v]] <- list(type = ty, codes = codes, scale = scale_codes, nr_raw = nr_raw, years = years, sparse = sparse)
  if (with_mean) corr_names <- c(corr_names, v)
}
cat(length(index_vars), "questions written in", format(Sys.time() - t0), "\n")
all_nr <- bind_rows(all_nr)
write.csv(all_nr, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "nonresponse_only_country_years.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(nrow(all_nr), "country-years left out because every answer was don't know / no answer (see output/nonresponse_only_country_years.csv)\n")
all_nr |> count(variable, sort = TRUE) |> head(15)
```

# Correlations, one year at a time

Weighted pairwise Pearson r within each country-year, for every pair of
ordered, yes/no or numeric questions asked that year (pairwise deletion,
at least `r MIN_PAIR_N` respondents). Nominal questions are never correlated.

```{r correlations}
corr_vars_by_year <- list(); cor_store <- list()
for (y in YEARS) {
  rows <- which(lb$year == y)
  vy <- corr_names[vapply(corr_names, function(v) y %in% var_meta[[v]]$years, logical(1))]
  X <- do.call(cbind, lapply(vy, function(v) {          # substantive (on-scale) answers only
    xv <- as.numeric(lb[[v]][rows]); ct <- ct_list[[v]]
    cl <- ct$class[match(xv, ct$code)]; xv[is.na(cl) | cl != "substantive"] <- NA; xv }))
  colnames(X) <- vy
  cty <- lb$iso[rows]; w_y <- wt[rows]
  res <- lapply(split(seq_along(rows), cty), function(r) weighted_pairwise_cor(X[r, , drop = FALSE], w_y[r]))
  keep_v <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(res, function(cc) diag(cc$n) >= MIN_PAIR_N))
  X <- X[, keep_v, drop = FALSE]; vy <- vy[keep_v]
  res <- lapply(res, function(cc) list(r = cc$r[keep_v, keep_v, drop = FALSE], n = cc$n[keep_v, keep_v, drop = FALSE]))
  for (j in seq_along(vy)) {
    keep <- names(res)[vapply(res, function(cc) cc$n[j, j] >= MIN_PAIR_N, logical(1))]
    rr <- lapply(res[keep], function(cc) arr(as.integer(round(1000 * cc$r[j, ]))))
    # pairwise N stored as n0 - dn: n0 = respondents valid on this item in the country,
    # dn = how many of them are missing on the other item (mostly 0; keeps files small)
    n0 <- lapply(res[keep], function(cc) as.integer(cc$n[j, j]))
    dn <- lapply(res[keep], function(cc) arr(as.integer(cc$n[j, j] - cc$n[j, ])))
    file_sizes[[length(file_sizes) + 1]] <- tibble(kind = "r", id = vy[j], year = y,
      bytes = write_json_compact(list(id = vy[j], year = y, r = rr, n0 = n0, dn = dn), file.path(OUT_DIR, "r", y, paste0(vy[j], ".json"))))
  }
  write_json_compact(list(year = y, corr = arr(vy)), file.path(OUT_DIR, "r", y, "index.json"))
  corr_vars_by_year[[as.character(y)]] <- vy
  cor_store[[as.character(y)]] <- list(X = X, cty = cty, wt = w_y, res = res)
  cat(y, ":", length(vy), "correlatable questions\n")
}
```

```{r manifest}
  waves = lapply(YEARS, function(y) list(id = y, label = as.character(y), years = as.character(y),

  countries = ctry_json,

  country_sets = COUNTRY_SETS,
  default_set = DEFAULT_SET,
  min_cell_n = MIN_CELL_N,
  n_questions = length(index_vars),
  default_trend = "A_001_001"
)
write_json_compact(manifest, file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json"))
```

# Checks

## Every cell adds up, and no cell exceeds its country-year

Percentages over valid respondents sum to 100 (within rounding), unweighted
counts sum to the valid N, nonresponse shares lie in 0–100, means lie on the
scale, and no cell has more respondents than its country-year has in
`LB_TimeSeries_Clean_v1_country_year.csv`.

```{r check-cells}
N_cy <- setNames(cy_ref$n, paste(cy_ref$year, iso_of[as.character(cy_ref$country_code)]))
check_cell <- function(e, rec, tag) {
  bad <- character()
  if (e$nv > 0) {
    p <- unlist(e$p); cnt <- unlist(e$c)
    if (abs(sum(p) - 100) > 0.05 * length(p) + 0.1) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "p-sum", sum(p)))
    if (!is.null(e$c) && sum(cnt) != e$nv) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "count-sum"))   # counts: all-respondent cells
    if (!is.null(e$m)) {
      lo <- if (rec$type == "continuous") unlist(rec$range)[1] else min(unlist(rec$codes))
      hi <- if (rec$type == "continuous") unlist(rec$range)[2] else max(unlist(rec$codes))
      if (e$m < lo - 1e-9 || e$m > hi + 1e-9) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "mean-range"))
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(e$q)) { q <- unlist(e$q); if (any(q < 0 | q > 100) || sum(q) > 100.1) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "q")) }
  if (e$n < e$nv) bad <- c(bad, paste(tag, "n<nv"))
  bad
}
problems <- character(); n_cells <- 0
for (v in names(var_meta)) {
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  for (y in names(rec$est)) {
    gf <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "g", y, paste0(v, ".json"))
    grp <- if (file.exists(gf)) fromJSON(gf, simplifyVector = FALSE)$est else list()
    for (cc in names(rec$est[[y]])) {
    e <- rec$est[[y]][[cc]]; n_cells <- n_cells + 1
    problems <- c(problems, check_cell(e, rec, paste(v, y, cc, "all")))
    if (e$n > N_cy[[paste(y, cc)]]) problems <- c(problems, paste(v, y, cc, "n > country-year N"))
    for (g in names(grp[[cc]])) {
      eg <- grp[[cc]][[g]]; n_cells <- n_cells + 1
      problems <- c(problems, check_cell(eg, rec, paste(v, y, cc, g)))
      if (eg$n > e$n) problems <- c(problems, paste(v, y, cc, g, "group n > all n"))
    }
  }}
}
cat(n_cells, "cells checked;", length(problems), "problems\n"); head(problems)
stopifnot(length(problems) == 0)
```

## Years and coverage

Each question's years equal the catalog's `years`; no Spain; no value for a
country-year that was not surveyed; no year outside the 24 survey years (so
nothing is interpolated).

```{r check-coverage}
cat_years <- setNames(lapply(strsplit(catalog$years, " "), as.integer), catalog$variable)
# the catalog was written before fix 4, which set K_004_081 1995 (a 5-point item) to -4
cat_years$K_004_081 <- setdiff(cat_years$K_004_081, 1995)
yr_diff <- names(var_meta)[!vapply(names(var_meta), function(v) setequal(var_meta[[v]]$years, intersect(cat_years[[v]], YEARS)), logical(1))]
yr_diff
stopifnot(length(yr_diff) == 0)
surveyed <- paste(cy_ref$year, iso_of[as.character(cy_ref$country_code)])
cov_bad <- 0
for (v in names(var_meta)) {
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  keys <- unlist(lapply(names(rec$est), function(y) paste(y, names(rec$est[[y]]))))
  cov_bad <- cov_bad + sum(!keys %in% surveyed) + sum(!as.integer(names(rec$est)) %in% LB_SURVEY_YEARS)
}
man <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
stopifnot(cov_bad == 0, !("ES" %in% names(man$countries)), length(man$countries) == 18,
          all(vapply(man$waves, function(w) w$id %in% LB_SURVEY_YEARS, logical(1))))
cat("Coverage OK:", length(var_meta), "questions; years match the catalog; every cell is a surveyed country-year\n")
```

## Random cells against `lb_cy_share()` and `lb_cy_mean()`, both bases

`LB_functions.R`'s helpers recompute at least 300 random country-year cells. The
only difference by design: positive codes this site treats as nonresponse
(listed in `catalogue_review.csv`, e.g. C_001_031 0 "No responde", vote
intention 92 "Voto secreto") are given code −2 before calling the helpers, which
otherwise count them as valid. The asked-base value is the browser's formula,
`p × (1 − Σ nonresponse / 100)`.

```{r check-random}
set.seed(20260930)
site_share <- function(cell, rec, success, base) {
  kk <- unlist(cell$k %||% rec$codes); p <- sum(unlist(cell$p)[kk %in% success])
  if (base == "asked") p <- p * (1 - sum(unlist(cell$q %||% list(0))) / 100)
  p
}
# lb_cy_share(base = "asked") gives 0% for a country-year where everyone is
# nonresponse; the site leaves those out (above). The reference does the same.
drop_nr_only <- function(cy, v) {
  if (!nrow(all_nr) || !v %in% all_nr$variable) return(cy)
  z <- all_nr[all_nr$variable == v, ]
  cy[!paste(cy$year, cy$country_code) %in% paste(z$year, code_of[z$iso2]), ]
}
helper_data <- function(v) {
  x <- lb[[v]]; pnr <- var_meta[[v]]$nr_raw; pnr <- pnr[pnr >= 0]
  if (length(pnr)) x[x %in% pnr] <- -2L
  tibble(year = lb$year, country_code = lb$country_code, weight = lb$weight, !!v := x)
}
eligible <- names(var_meta)[vapply(var_meta, function(m) m$type != "continuous", logical(1))]
recheck <- map_dfr(1:400, function(k) {
  v <- sample(eligible, 1); m <- var_meta[[v]]
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  y <- sample(names(rec$est), 1); cc <- sample(names(rec$est[[y]]), 1); cell <- rec$est[[y]][[cc]]
  kk <- unlist(cell$k %||% rec$codes)
  success <- if (length(kk) > 1 && runif(1) < 0.5) sample(kk, 2) else sample(kk, 1)
  hd <- helper_data(v) |> filter(year == as.integer(y), country_code == code_of[[cc]])
  ref_v <- lb_cy_share(hd, v, success, base = "valid")$share
  ref_a <- if (any(hd[[v]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) lb_cy_share(hd, v, success, base = "asked")$share else ref_v
  ref_m <- if (m$type != "nominal" && !is.null(cell$m)) lb_cy_mean(hd, v, range = m$scale)$mean else NA
  tibble(var = v, year = y, country = cc, k_codes = length(success),
         d_valid = abs(site_share(cell, rec, success, "valid") - ref_v),
         d_asked = abs(site_share(cell, rec, success, "asked") - ref_a),
         d_mean  = if (is.na(ref_m)) 0 else abs(cell$m - ref_m))
})
recheck |> summarise(cells = n(), vars = n_distinct(var), max_valid = max(d_valid), max_asked = max(d_asked), max_mean = max(d_mean))
stopifnot(nrow(recheck) >= 300, all(recheck$d_valid <= 0.051 * recheck$k_codes + 1e-9),
          all(recheck$d_asked <= 0.101 * recheck$k_codes + 1e-9), all(recheck$d_mean < 0.0006))
```

## Regional lines equal `lb_region()` for every featured trend

The browser averages country values over a fixed set and shows a year only
when every member has data. Here the same rule is applied to the published
files and compared with `lb_region()` (and `allow_missing = TRUE` for the
unbalanced set). Years listed in `trend_breaks.csv` are left out of trends.
`pipeline/check_regions.mjs` repeats this with the site's own JavaScript.

```{r check-regions}
featured <- trend_ind$variable[trend_ind$featured == "1"]
region_ref <- list(); reg_cmp <- list()
for (v in featured) {
  ind <- index_vars[[which(vapply(index_vars, `[[`, "", "id") == v)]]$d
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(v, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  brk <- trend_breaks(v, trend_brk)$years
  hd <- helper_data(v)
  for (base in if (ind$type == "mean") "mean" else c("valid", "asked")) {
    cy <- if (base == "mean") lb_cy_mean(hd, v, range = var_meta[[v]]$scale) |> rename(value = mean)
          else drop_nr_only(lb_cy_share(hd, v, unlist(ind$codes), base = base), v) |> rename(value = share)
    for (s in COUNTRY_SETS) {
      ref <- lb_region(cy, value = "value", countries = code_of[s$countries], allow_missing = !s$balanced) |>
        filter(!is.na(value), !year %in% brk)
      site <- bind_rows(tibble(year = integer(), site = double(), n_c = integer()), map_dfr(names(rec$est), function(y) {
        if (as.integer(y) %in% brk) return(NULL)
        vals <- map_dbl(s$countries, function(cc) {
          e <- rec$est[[y]][[cc]]; if (is.null(e) || e$nv == 0) return(NA_real_)
          if (base == "mean") e$m %||% NA_real_ else site_share(e, rec, unlist(ind$codes), base)
        })
        if (s$balanced && anyNA(vals)) return(NULL)
        if (all(is.na(vals))) return(NULL)
        tibble(year = as.integer(y), site = mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE), n_c = sum(!is.na(vals)))
      }))
      j <- full_join(ref, site, by = "year")
      reg_cmp[[length(reg_cmp) + 1]] <- j |> mutate(var = v, base = base, set = s$id, balanced = s$balanced)
      region_ref[[length(region_ref) + 1]] <- ref |> mutate(var = v, base = base, set = s$id)
    }
  }
}
reg_cmp <- bind_rows(reg_cmp)
reg_cmp |> group_by(base) |> summarise(points = n(), max_diff = max(abs(value - site)), missing = sum(is.na(value) | is.na(site)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(reg_cmp$value), !anyNA(reg_cmp$site),
          all(abs(reg_cmp$value - reg_cmp$site) < ifelse(reg_cmp$base == "mean", 0.0006, 0.101)),
          all(reg_cmp$n_c == reg_cmp$n_countries))
# n_countries is constant along every balanced line
stopifnot(all(reg_cmp |> filter(balanced) |> group_by(var, base, set) |> summarise(k = n_distinct(n_countries), .groups = "drop") |> pull(k) == 1))
write.csv(bind_rows(region_ref), file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "region_reference.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
reg_cmp |> filter(var == "A_001_001", set == "bal16", base == "valid") |> select(year, value, site, n_countries)
```

## Benchmarks against published figures

% "democracy is preferable" pooled over every country surveyed that year, don't
know / no answer in the base (the cleaning notebook's `pooled()`), must be 47.8,
48.0 and 51.6 for 2018, 2023 and 2024 (published: 48, 48, 52). The site's
country cells for those years must equal `lb_cy_share(base = "asked")`. The
crime-victim rate must lie between 22% and 45% in every year it was asked
(rounded to whole percent, as in the audit notes; 2017 is 21.9%).

```{r check-benchmarks}
pooled <- function(dat, var, success, years) {
  x <- as.double(dat[[var]])
  tibble(year = dat$year, w = dat$weight, x = x) %>%
    filter(year %in% years, !is.na(x), x >= 0 | x %in% c(-1, -2, -5)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>% summarise(pct = round(100 * sum(w * (x %in% success)) / sum(w), 1))
}
if (all(c(2018, 2023, 2024) %in% YEARS)) {
  bench <- pooled(lb, "A_001_001", 1, c(2018, 2023, 2024)) %>% mutate(expected = c(47.8, 48.0, 51.6), published = c(48, 48, 52))
  print(bench)
  stopifnot(all(bench$pct == bench$expected))
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", "A_001_001.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  ref <- drop_nr_only(lb_cy_share(helper_data("A_001_001") |> filter(year %in% c(2018, 2023, 2024)), "A_001_001", 1, base = "asked"), "A_001_001")
  site <- pmap_dbl(ref, function(year, country_code, n, share) site_share(rec$est[[as.character(year)]][[iso_of[[as.character(country_code)]]]], rec, 1, "asked"))
  cat("2018/2023/2024 country cells, asked base: max |site - lb_cy_share| =", max(abs(site - ref$share)), "over", nrow(ref), "cells\n")
  stopifnot(max(abs(site - ref$share)) <= 0.101)
}
victim <- pooled(lb |> mutate(v = I_001_001_victim), "v", 1, YEARS) |> rename(pooled_asked = pct) |>
  left_join(lb[, .(valid = round(100 * sum(weight * (I_001_001_victim == 1L), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(weight[I_001_001_victim >= 0], na.rm = TRUE), 1)),
               by = year], by = "year")
victim <- victim |> filter(!is.na(valid))        # 2000: not asked
victim
# "22-45%" is the audit's range rounded to whole percent: 2017 is 21.9% (valid) / 21.6% (asked).
stopifnot(nrow(victim) == length(setdiff(YEARS, 2000)),
          all(round(victim$valid) >= 22 & round(victim$valid) <= 45),
          all(round(victim$pooled_asked) >= 22 & round(victim$pooled_asked) <= 45))
rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", "I_001_001_victim.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
site_cy <- unlist(lapply(rec$est, function(yy) vapply(yy, function(e) site_share(e, rec, 1, "valid"), 0)))
summary(site_cy)
```

## Correlations match `stats::cov.wt`; nothing meaningless is correlated

```{r check-corr}
set.seed(7)
corr_check <- map_dfr(names(cor_store), function(y) {
  cs <- cor_store[[y]]
  map_dfr(1:20, function(k) {
    cc <- sample(names(cs$res), 1); rows <- which(cs$cty == cc)
    j <- sample(ncol(cs$X), 2)
    ref <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(cor_reference(cs$X[rows, j[1]], cs$X[rows, j[2]], cs$wt[rows]), error = function(e) NA))
    tibble(year = y, country = cc, a = colnames(cs$X)[j[1]], b = colnames(cs$X)[j[2]], mine = cs$res[[cc]]$r[j[1], j[2]], ref = ref)
  })
}) |> filter(!is.na(mine))
cat(nrow(corr_check), "pairs compared; max abs diff", signif(max(abs(corr_check$mine - corr_check$ref)), 2), "\n")
stopifnot(nrow(corr_check) >= 8 * length(YEARS), max(abs(corr_check$mine - corr_check$ref)) < 1e-8)
all_corr <- unique(unlist(corr_vars_by_year))
stopifnot(!any(all_corr %in% ADMIN_VARS), !any(all_corr %in% catalogue$variable[catalogue$type == "nominal"]))
```

## Payload sizes

```{r sizes}
sizes <- bind_rows(file_sizes)
gz <- function(paths) vapply(paths, function(p) length(memCompress(readBin(p, "raw", file.size(p)), "gzip")), 0)
cat("Total:", nrow(sizes), "files,", round(sum(sizes$bytes) / 1e6, 1), "MB\n")
sizes |> group_by(kind) |> summarise(files = n(), total_MB = round(sum(bytes) / 1e6, 1),
                                     median_KB = round(median(bytes) / 1e3, 1), max_KB = round(max(bytes) / 1e3, 1))
big <- sizes |> arrange(desc(bytes)) |> head(8)
big$gz_KB <- round(gz(ifelse(big$kind == "v", file.path(OUT_DIR, "v", paste0(big$id, ".json")),
                             file.path(OUT_DIR, big$kind, big$year, paste0(big$id, ".json")))) / 1e3, 1)
big
c(index_KB = round(file.size(file.path(OUT_DIR, "index.json")) / 1e3, 1),
  index_gz_KB = round(gz(file.path(OUT_DIR, "index.json")) / 1e3, 1),
  manifest_KB = round(file.size(file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json")) / 1e3, 1))
write.csv(sizes, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "file_sizes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Publish

All checks passed, so the staged files replace the site's data.

```{r publish}
for (d in c("v", "g", "r")) unlink(file.path(FINAL_DIR, d), recursive = TRUE)
for (d in c("v", "g", "r")) stopifnot(file.rename(file.path(OUT_DIR, d), file.path(FINAL_DIR, d)) ||
                                       file.copy(file.path(OUT_DIR, d), FINAL_DIR, recursive = TRUE))
for (f in c("manifest.json", "index.json")) file.copy(file.path(OUT_DIR, f), file.path(FINAL_DIR, f), overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Published to", normalizePath(FINAL_DIR), "\n")
```
